name: Sales {OS}

group.label: 04 · GROW
group.purpose: Turn value into distribution and revenue

tagline: Pipeline, conversations and the close, without manipulation.

commands.name: /sales
commands.does: Opens the OS and reports what needs attention today
commands.returns: opportunities with a next action, and those that have gone quiet

commands.name: /sales-pipeline
commands.does: Shows pipeline state by stage, grounded in buyer actions
commands.returns: every open opportunity with stage, owner, next action and last buyer action

commands.name: /qualify
commands.does: Qualifies a lead on fit, need, authority, timing and budget
commands.returns: a qualification verdict with every unknown marked unknown

commands.name: /disqualify
commands.does: Records a disqualification and the reason given to the prospect
commands.returns: a disqualification record and the message to send

commands.name: /sales-call
commands.returns: an agenda, the permitted claim set, and the questions to ask

commands.name: /sales-discovery
commands.does: Runs discovery and captures the need in the buyer's words
commands.returns: a need record, quoted, with the decision process named

commands.name: /sales-objection
commands.does: Answers an objection using only sourced claims
commands.returns: a response with a source per claim, or an explicit abstention

commands.name: /sales-proposal
commands.does: Drafts a proposal against a live offer and price book version
commands.returns: a proposal naming offer version, price book version and claim sources

commands.name: /sales-negotiate
commands.does: Settles price and terms inside the discount policy
commands.returns: a settled position, or an escalation to the Pricing floor owner

commands.name: /sales-close
commands.does: Runs the close and records the signed commitment
commands.returns: a signed commitment with the exact approved contract text

commands.name: /closed-won
commands.does: Produces the handoff carrying every promise made
commands.returns: the closed won handoff, emitted to Revenue and Delivery

commands.name: /loss-review
commands.does: Records why a deal was really lost
commands.returns: a loss review with the stated reason and the believed reason

commands.name: /sales-review
commands.does: Audits pipeline hygiene and claim discipline
commands.returns: findings: stale stages, unsourced claims, unrecorded promises

handoffs.artifact: closed won commitment and agreed scope
closed won commitment and agreed scope

requires_human_approval_for: sending any proposal, quote or contract
committing to any scope, deliverable or date not already in the offer
quoting any price outside the price book, including any discount below the policy floor
naming a customer, a logo or a result in a conversation or a document
issuing a closed won handoff to Revenue {OS} and Delivery & Customer Success {OS}
the exact text of any customer-facing message, proposal or contract
